Name: Cozy Backyard (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This adds a Backyard to your farmhouse with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Indoor Farm[/url]. You can use it to grow crops, plant trees, beekeeping, backyard chickens (or other animals) or simply decorate. Or all of the above! It's basically a tiny little farm behind your house.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it.


[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]
[/b]
[list]
[*]Grass tiles tillable
[*]Buildable location
[*]Forest fish
[*]no weeds or dirt decay
[*]some berry bushes
[*]hang the painting of the season (or other furniture) on the tree
[/list][b]

[/b][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528224.png[/img][/b]

Should be compatible with everything.


[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528397.png[/img][/b]

Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and Personal Indoor Farm. 1.6. is required.[b]


[/b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528525.png[/img]
